narrative.headline: BONK reclaims the dog-coin narrative as Solana DEX volume rebounds
narrative.summary: Mentions of BONK on X are up 41% over 24h, led by mid-size accounts rather than the usual promo cluster. The dominant frame is a rotation back into Solana majors after two weeks of L2 attention. Contrarian read: engagement is rising faster than unique authors, which historically front-runs a 2-3 day fade.
